name: Self Love
overview: Scripture teaches that true self love is grounded in recognizing our God-given worth as fearfully and wonderfully made, as expressed in Psalms 139:14, and guarding our hearts diligently since they determine the course of our lives (Proverbs 4:23). While external beauty and favor are fleeting, reverence for the Lord brings genuine praise (Proverbs 31:30). Jesus commands us to love God fully and to love our neighbors as ourselves, implying a balanced, God-centered love for oneself that values the life God has intricately formed and sustains (Matthew 22:37; Mark 12:31; Luke 12:7).
